# DestiX AI | Autonomous Telephony & AI Voice Agent Practice (ayush.company)

> DestiX AI (primary domain: https://ayush.company) is the premier autonomous voice engineering studio in Delhi NCR and India, founded and led by Principal AI Systems Architect Ayush Meena. We build carrier-grade, sub-500ms voice agents fluent in English, Hindi, and colloquial Hinglish, paired with automated CRM pipelines and spatial 3D WebGL web applications.

## Core Services & Capabilities
- [AI Voice Agents for Real Estate](https://ayush.company/ai-voice-agent-for-real-estate): Sub-45s outbound callback automation for 99acres, MagicBricks, Housing.com, and Meta Ads leads. Automatically qualifies budgets (₹3 Cr to ₹25 Cr+), BHK specifications, and schedules private site visits directly to sales directors' calendars.
- [AI Voice Agent Agency Delhi NCR](https://ayush.company/ai-voice-agent-delhi-ncr): Turnkey telecalling and inbound receptionist infrastructure for enterprises in New Delhi (Connaught Place, South Delhi), Gurugram (Golf Course Road, Cyber City), and Noida (Expressway Corridors).
- [Transparent Pricing & Unit Economics](https://ayush.company/pricing): Wholesale pass-through carrier minutes (~₹4.50 to ₹7.50/min), zero recurring software seat markups, 100% client code ownership, and a strict 5x Hurdle Rate financial commitment.
- [Production Playbooks & Blueprints](https://ayush.company/playbooks): 6 verified commercial blueprints across Luxury Real Estate, Healthcare Patient Triage, High-Ticket B2B Sales, Luxury Hospitality, D2C Abandoned Checkout Recovery, and Agency White-Label.
- [Verified Client Case Studies](https://ayush.company/case-studies): Real operational deployments for Alliance Capital Properties (AED 85M+ pipeline), Pranav Jha Studio, DigiiRox 3D Experience, and Birch Stays.
- [Websites & 3D WebGL](https://ayush.company/websites): High-performance Next.js 15 digital flagships and interactive 60 FPS Three.js spatial experiences.
- [White-Label AI Agency Partner](https://ayush.company/partners/agency-white-label): Multi-tenant voice core and frontend execution for marketing and growth consultancies.

## Key Telemetry & Performance Benchmarks
- Speed-to-Lead Outbound Trigger: Under 15 to 45 seconds from web form or portal webhook
- Turn-Taking Latency: 435ms p50 measured end-to-end roundtrip (Speech -> TTFT -> TTS -> Carrier)
- Domestic Telephony: Tier-1 TRAI/DLT compliant +91 mobile virtual numbers, 011 Delhi, and 0124 Gurugram PRI landline trunks via Tata Tele, Airtel, and Exotel
- CRM Bi-Directional Synchronization: Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, LeadSquared, Follow Up Boss, and GoHighLevel in under 2 seconds
- Economic Hurdle Rate: 5x minimum projected ROI requirement before accepting any client engagement
